title: Mapping object space dimensions: new insights from temporal dynamics
description: This dataset comprises raw EEG recordings collected to investigate the temporal dynamics underlying object space dimensions in human perception. Participants completed a rapid image presentation task while EEG data were recorded, enabling analysis of the time course of object representation. The dataset includes behavioral event data alongside BIDS-formatted EEG recordings, supporting research into visual object processing and neural representational geometry.
methods_description: EEG data were collected during a task in which participants viewed a series of target images. Raw EEG recordings were stored in BDF format, with accompanying event files detailing stimulus presentation and channel/sampling rate information for each trial.
